droid-monkey attacked this Android app with a real-world fault and it failed. Fix the root cause.

## What happened
Attack `rotation` (rotation): Rotate the device while work started by a tap is still running, or on a filled form.
Steps: [{"fill": true}, {"tap": "product_1"}, {"wait": 1.2}, {"fault": "rotate"}, {"settle": 8.0}]
Result: crashed: java.lang.IllegalStateException: FragmentManager has been destroyed
Crash: java.lang.IllegalStateException @ com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui.DealLoader$load$1.invokeSuspend(DetailScreen.kt:64)
  at com.shubhasai.monkeymart.ui.DealLoader$load$1.invokeSuspend(DetailScreen.kt:64)

## Diagnosis
Root cause: DetailScreen.kt:72-75 captures the current Activity from LocalContext and passes it into DealLoader.load, which launches on GlobalScope (DetailScreen.kt:57-58). The coroutine outlives the composition and the Activity. On rotation MainActivity is destroyed and recreated (MainActivity.kt:33-34), but the old coroutine still resumes after ProductRepository.byId (DetailScreen.kt:59) and calls show() on the dead activity's supportFragmentManager (DetailScreen.kt:62-64). That FragmentManager is already destroyed, so it throws IllegalStateException. The design mistake is an unscoped coroutine that holds a UI-owned, recreatable object.
Fix approach: Remove GlobalScope and the Activity parameter from DealLoader. Load the product and deal inside the composable's LaunchedEffect(productId), which is cancelled on rotation, or in a ViewModel using viewModelScope with the productId kept in SavedStateHandle. Show the deal as Compose state (for example an AlertDialog driven by a dealMessage state variable) instead of a DialogFragment that needs the activity's FragmentManager. Then nothing touches a destroyed FragmentManager.
Evidence: app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/DetailScreen.kt:57-58 - DealLoader.load launches on GlobalScope(Dispatchers.Main), which is not tied to any lifecycle; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/DetailScreen.kt:59-60 - suspend repository call, then onLoaded runs after the load completes, even if the activity has been destroyed; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/DetailScreen.kt:62-64 - DealDialogFragment.show(activity.supportFragmentManager) on the captured activity's FragmentManager, which throws once that activity is destroyed (the crash site); app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/DetailScreen.kt:72 - LocalContext cast to FragmentActivity captures the activity instance that rotation destroys; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/DetailScreen.kt:74-75 - LaunchedEffect calls DealLoader.load with that captured activity, so the scoped effect still hands an unscoped coroutine an old activity; app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/MainActivity.kt:33-34 - setContent recreates the whole UI tree on rotation, so the activity captured by the old coroutine is destroyed

## Files to change
- app/src/main/java/com/shubhasai/monkeymart/ui/DetailScreen.kt

## Regression test
Add an instrumented test class DetailRotationTest in src/androidTest. Launch MainActivity with ActivityScenario, click the row tagged product_1 (a product with a deal), call scenario.recreate() immediately while the load is still running, then idle. Assert that the app has not crashed, that detail_name is displayed, and that the deal text is shown. This fails before the fix with the same IllegalStateException and passes after it.

## Rules
- Fix the root cause in the files above with the idiomatic Android approach. Keep the change small and focused.
- Add exactly one regression test file under app/src/test (JVM unit test, preferred) or app/src/androidTest
  (instrumented), using only test libraries the project already has (see app/build.gradle.kts). It must fail on
  the old code and pass on the fixed code.
- Do not change build files or add dependencies. Do not touch unrelated code. Do not commit.
- When done, reply with one short paragraph: what you changed and the test class name.

29	    override fun onCreate(savedInstanceState: Bundle?) {
30	        super.onCreate(savedInstanceState)
31	        enableEdgeToEdge()
32	        setContent {
33	            MonkeyMartTheme {
34	                MonkeyMartApp()

40	/** Screens are addressed by a small route string so the back stack survives recreation. */
41	sealed interface Route {
42	    data object Shop : Route
43	    data class Detail(val productId: Int) : Route
44	    data class Checkout(val productId: Int) : Route
45	}
46	
47	private fun Route.encode(): String = when (this) {
48	    Route.Shop -> "shop"
49	    is Route.Detail -> "detail:$productId"
50	    is Route.Checkout -> "checkout:$productId"
51	}
52	
53	private fun decodeRoute(raw: String): Route = when {
54	    raw.startsWith("detail:") -> Route.Detail(raw.removePrefix("detail:").toInt())
55	    raw.startsWith("checkout:") -> Route.Checkout(raw.removePrefix("checkout:").toInt())
56	    else -> Route.Shop
57	}
58	
59	@OptIn(ExperimentalMaterial3Api::class, ExperimentalComposeUiApi::class)
60	@Composable
61	fun MonkeyMartApp() {
62	    var rawRoute by rememberSaveable { mutableStateOf(Route.Shop.encode()) }
63	    val route = decodeRoute(rawRoute)
64	    fun go(to: Route) { rawRoute = to.encode() }
65	
66	    BackHandler(enabled = route != Route.Shop) {
67	        go(if (route is Route.Checkout) Route.Detail(route.productId) else Route.Shop)
68	    }
69	
70	    Scaffold(
71	        modifier = Modifier
72	            .fillMaxSize()
73	            .semantics { testTagsAsResourceId = true },
74	        topBar = { TopAppBar(title = { Text("MonkeyMart") }) },
75	    ) { padding ->
76	        val content = Modifier.padding(padding)
77	        when (route) {
78	            Route.Shop -> ShopScreen(onProductClick = { go(Route.Detail(it)) }, modifier = content)
79	            is Route.Detail -> DetailScreen(route.productId, onBuyNow = { go(Route.Checkout(it)) }, modifier = content)
80	            is Route.Checkout -> CheckoutScreen(route.productId, modifier = content)
81	        }
82	    }
83	}

content.text:
I fixed the rotation crash in `DetailScreen.kt` but haven't compiled it or run any tests, including the new one.

I removed `DealLoader` (the `GlobalScope` coroutine that held the old `FragmentActivity`) and `DealDialogFragment`. The product load now runs inside `LaunchedEffect(productId)`, so rotation cancels it, and nothing touches a destroyed `FragmentManager`. The deal now appears as a Compose `AlertDialog` driven by a `dealMessage` state, with the text tagged `deal_text`. After rotation the screen reloads the product and shows the deal again.

The regression test is `DetailRotationTest` in `src/androidTest`. It opens `product_1`, calls `scenario.recreate()` mid-load, and asserts that `detail_name` and "10% off Banana Bunch, today only." are displayed. Against the old code it should fail with the same `IllegalStateException`.
